observations.rationale: The cluster after byed is fused/overwritten in the native scan. Two visual inspections did not establish the exact pa'i rgyu sequence independently. component_inventory.features: Raised curved mark, enclosed upper counter, dense lower hooked/stacked strokes, then an angular rightward body with a descending terminal stroke. component_inventory.reading: Additional letters remain unresolved; the left part has a ra-like hooked form and ma-like angular body, tentatively ར…མ…, and the right part contains a conspicuous subjoined loop.

component_inventory.confidence: High that an additional substantial group exists; low for its letter assignments.

component_inventory.features: A distinct long vertical stroke closes the preceding graphic group.

component_inventory.confidence: Moderate overall; higher for the ending.
